Spike Force mixes roguelite deckbuilding, 90's action anime, and high school volleyball. Build your team, pick your cards, and represent your school in a supernatural battle for the fate of humanity.

Every match is a fight for survival. You draft a roster of characters, each with their own deck and playstyle, then build your hand before stepping onto the court. Serves, spikes, blocks, and sets all come from cards, so every point is a decision, not just a button press - and explosive elemental combos and Limit Breaks are a must if you hope to win.

Win matches to push your school further up the ladder. Each run branches into different paths, rivals, and events, all wrapped in the over the top energy of the 90's beat em ups and action anime shows that inspired it. Lose a set and you might still claw your way back. Lose the match and your run is over, so every game counts.

Key Features

  • A full roster of characters, each with their own deck and playstyle

  • Roguelite structure with branching runs and permanent unlocks

  • Relics and card upgrades that let you build wild combos

  • Epic boss battles that span space and time

  • 90's anime inspired presentation, tone, and story

  • Fast matches built for quick runs or long sessions

If you grew up on 90's beat em ups, action anime and love a good deckbuilder, Spike Force puts it all in one game.

Spill The Ink is a cozy physics puzzle game where every solution starts with a single stroke. Study the chamber, draw one continuous line, and release it. Gravity takes over. A ramp, a nudge, a wildly unlikely idea! Your ink becomes part of the puzzle.

Send the paper ball through portals, catch a breeze from fans, and work around spinning saws. Experiment with shapes and timing, learn from each attempt, and find your own clever way through.

Build custom chambers with platforms, obstacles, goals, and interactive zones. Test your idea, solve it, and share it through Steam Workshop. Browse player-made puzzles and collections when you're ready for a fresh challenge.

Find your flow. Then chase three stars.

  • Explore a campaign of handcrafted physics puzzles.

  • Use less ink, improve your personal best, and earn all three stars.

  • Build, test, and share your own levels.

  • Discover new challenges from the community.

Relax, experiment, and spill a little ink.

Build your deck. Break their fortress.

Spirefall is a single-player roguelite deckbuilder with turn-based card battles. Deploy units, cast spells, and unleash fortress weapons to break the enemy stronghold. Between battles, choose your route and reshape your deck for the next opponent.

Command the battle. Fire the whole battery.

Choose your attackers, commit your blockers, and answer enemy plays with spells. Your commander and fortress start on the table, bringing their own abilities to your strategy from the first turn.

Build a line of charged beam weapons, then give the order to fire them all. Fund assassins and bring out the cannons. Or wait for the Blood Moon and let your vampires hunt. Every faction runs on a different economy, and it changes how you build your deck and fight your battles.

Build a stronger deck at every table.

Take on the Gauntlet: a branching run of card battles, encounters, shops, and bosses. Scout the opponents ahead, choose your path, and spend your winnings on the cards your strategy needs. Collect Emblems that change how your run plays.

Unlock new commanders, fortresses, and cards for future runs. Beat the boss and preserve your winning deck as a Trophy Deck, ready to take into another run.

Three taverns. Three sets of house rules.

Every tavern runs its own Gauntlet, with its own opponents, its own stock, and a boss who does not play fair.

  • Tully's Ale Haus: The Tavern Keeper holds the last table, and her Kraken grabs your units and hurls them into your fortress.

  • The Undercroft: Beneath the cathedral of Antiok, attack the congregation and your units are marked with Sin. The Church locks your units in its Chambers, and the Confessor digs for relics at the final table.

  • Hotel Madame Noire: A shared Clock runs through Day and Night. Every second Dusk brings a Blood Moon, when vampires grow stronger and hunt freely until Dawn burns the ones left exposed.

Five factions. Five ways to win.

Start with the Archmage Technocrats and earn four more banners through play. Each faction brings its own resources, commanders, fortresses, and cards:

  • Archmage Technocrats: Build your energy reserves, cast spells, and line up devastating beam salvos.

  • The Merchant Coast: Turn gold into hired muscle, assassination contracts, and cannon fire.

  • Guild of the Inglorious Bards: Rotate instruments to change your units' abilities and make the next verse hurt.

  • The Nine of the Sacred: Collect Tithe and Divine Favor, mark enemies with Sin, and make the sinful pay. Defeat the Confessor to take up their banner.

  • The Sovereign: Feed your vampires, store their Blood, and strike when the Blood Moon rises. Defeat Madame Noire to join her court.

Welcome to Spirefall, where rival factions settle their grudges over cards and the innkeepers take winning personally. Merchant princes count coin. Technocrats calibrate their contraptions. Bards lie about everything. The Church keeps count of your sins, and the vampire court keeps the wine flowing. You have a starter deck and a reputation to build.

Take a seat. Play the free demo.

The free demo includes three taverns, five factions, and more than 350 cards to collect, among them over 20 commanders and 15 fortresses. Play with mouse and keyboard or full controller support, including on Steam Deck.

The full game takes the Gauntlet further. The Ferryman's Rest waits in Apopis, where the Risen Kingdom has been playing for a very long time, and more taverns follow, each with its own host, opponents, boss, and new cards to build around.

Try the free demo and wishlist Spirefall for release. The tavern keeper does not lose politely.

Strike, rebound, and climb

Spirestorm is a single-player arcade action roguelite. Launch into a tower of monsters, dive, strike with your sword, and rebound upward. Steer midair, brake into a slow fall, and climb before the rising fire catches you. Unlock Ember Nova to parry projectiles, Aegis to counter blows, and Skybreaker to regain height with lightning.

Risk the haul

Travel through ten realms across a connected 25,400-metre tower. At return bells, bank your gold or carry it higher; fall and unbanked treasure is lost, while earned experience remains. Spend banked gold across 30 forge upgrades, develop 45 talents in Ember, Iron, and Gale, and unlock earned basecamps as you progress through 40 levels.

  • Fight 30 enemy types, ten guardians, and minibosses.
  • Practice encounters in Boss Trials or climb through four difficulty modes.
  • Keyboard and mouse controls.

YOUR FRIENDS ARE THE SCARY PART.

SPIRITS: WAKE UP! is an online horror party game for 2–8 players. Deep in a PSX-style sewer, Ghosts complete tasks and dodge Hunters. Bring your friends: the next scream might ruin the entire plan.

SPEAK. INFLATE. GO QUIET. GIVE CHASE.

As a Hunter, use your microphone to inflate your head and build movement energy, then go quiet and chase. Push too far and your head bursts, sending you to the floor and giving the Ghosts a chance to escape.

SMALL GHOST. BIG PROBLEM.

As a Ghost, float through dark passages, complete tasks and rescue captured friends. Time your limited flight and choose abilities such as invisibility, dash or a clone. Finish the task objective or survive until time runs out; Hunters win by catching every Ghost.

ONE MORE ROUND?

Choose your character, try abilities in the playable lobby and adjust the round length, task objective and Hunter count for your group. Rusty pipes, dim lights and your friends' terrible timing make every chase a story worth retelling.

What Splorbit is

A horde survival game built on ball physics. You move, your balls fire themselves, and everything they hit bounces, splits, chains or explodes. Enemies come at you from every side, and the longer you last, the denser it gets.

What the full game includes

  • 5 worlds, each with its own enemies and bosses.
  • 5+ playable characters, each with a signature weapon and a permanent upgrade ladder
  • 12 balls with their own physics, and 3 evo-versions per ball
  • Buffs that stack with the balls, and gambits that offer risk vs. reward on stats
  • Different enemy categories to contend with: bosses, elites and champions
  • Local co-op for 2 to 4 players on one screen
  • Online leaderboards
  • An in-game Compendium with a playable sandbox for every entry

How a run works

You control movement. Balls auto-launch and smash through whatever is coming at you. Enemies drop gems, gems fill the mana bar, and every full bar hands you a pick from the upgrade deck. Survive 20 minutes to clear the world, then keep going in endless mode for the leaderboard.

Bosses

Bosses are made of iron and gold. Iron is impregnable but you can damage the gold bits. Gold areas might be hidden, might grow back or may be difficult to hit. Break all the gold and the boss goes down.

Between runs

Gold you collect buys permanent character upgrades. New characters unlock by completing survival missions.

Controls

Mouse and keyboard or gamepad. Auto-fire and auto-aim that you can override with twin-stick mode at any time. Built for PC and Steam Deck.

Sponge Bridges is a delivery-focused post-apocalyptic survival game paying homage to Death Stranding and Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead.

Reconnect a Broken World

Cargo is not just a number in your inventory.

It may decide whether an entire city is destroyed by a nuclear strike.

Slaughter, or Salvation?

Shooting and cutting them down are not your only options.

They can stop and eat.

This Is an Entire Post-Apocalyptic World

Nothing in this world is merely decoration.

An enormous variety of monsters · items · world elements · buildings

A vast seed-generated world.

Find towns, enter buildings, climb onto rooftops, and descend underground.

Meet all kinds of people in different places, and keep getting swept into new troubles and choices along the way.

Spook & Sell

Stage the haunt. Sell the house.

You're the world's most desperate real-estate agents. The listing is haunted, the open house starts in minutes, and the buyers cannot find out. Hide every ghost, vacuum the ectoplasm, nail down the floating furniture — then smile through the tour before the haunting meter tips over.

A chaotic co-op open house

Team up with up to 4 players online. Race through prep, then survive the selling phase as curious buyers, clingy dogs, and nosy inspectors poke through every closet. One sighting can send the meter climbing. One wrong answer can blow the deal. Keep everyone calm long enough to plant the sold sign.

How a round works

  • Prep — Stash Wailers, Floaters, and Smashers in closets, under beds, showers, and worse. Clean the mess. Freeze cursed furniture before it drifts into view.

  • Selling — Buyers walk the house. Answer their questions, pet the dog, slam doors (carefully), and keep ghosts out of sightlines.

  • Close the deal — Keep the haunting meter under control until the clock runs out… or watch the buyers flee screaming.

Tools of the trade

Each agent brings a fixed two-tool loadout. Coordinate who sees what:

  • X-Ray Glasses — Spot and grab ghosts others can’t see

  • Vacuum — Suck up ectoplasm before buyers step in it

  • Freeze Spray — Pin floating furniture to the floor

  • Clipboard — Track the floor plan and buyer locations

Features

  • 1–4 player online co-op chaos

  • Physics-powered ghost wrangling, throws, and house mayhem

  • Distinct buyer personalities — from speedwalkers to closet inspectors

  • A cast of quirky agents with unique tool combos

  • Quick Play, private lobbies, and join-with-code sessions

  • Controller support

The house is cursed. The clients are coming. Don’t blow the listing.

A game by Crushed Olives Studios

Spot the difference before anyone else.

The screen is packed with near-identical characters and pictures. Hidden among them is exactly one that's different. Find it and click it. That's the only rule.

But 王 and 主, 千 and 干, ほ and は — when the board grows to 392 tiles, how long can your eyes keep up?

3 Rules

  • Time Attack — Beat the time limit on every question. Run out of time and it's on to the next one.
  • Quick Challenge — How many questions can you clear within the set time?
  • 100-Question Exam — A speedrun through all 100 questions. It gets harder as you go, and there's no time limit.

5 Difficulty Levels

From 32 tiles on Beginner up to 28 × 14 = 392 tiles on Ultimate. The more tiles there are, the deeper that one difference hides. You can set the time limit and the number of questions freely, so play a quick one-minute round or settle in and run all 100 questions.

Online Matches for Up to 8 Players

Just send the lobby code shown by the host, and compete with friends on the same questions at the same time. Enjoy every close finish — misclick penalties included — right up to the final rankings.

Relay (Online Only)

Only the presenter knows the correct character or picture, and they describe it out loud. Everyone else searches for it on their own board, where the tiles are arranged differently — a twist that also tests the presenter's skill at describing. The presenter earns a point for every player who answers their question correctly. Each question you fail to answer costs you 1 point.
*There is no built-in voice chat. Please use an external voice chat tool.

Collection

Every question you've been given is recorded, so you can look back through them later in a list. They look alike, yet they're definitely different — taking a slow second look at those differences is a pleasure of its own.

Free Demo Available

Try the Beginner boards and online matches for free. Start by finding out how far your eyes can take you.

A roguelite deck-building strategy game where everything serves one purpose: conquering the arena. Build powerful decks, upgrade your cell to unlock crafting systems like cooking, brewing, and incubation, and endure arena labor to earn the resources needed to survive and dominate.

Fight in the arena

Furnish your cell

Enhance your cards

Cook your own meals

Incubate new fighters

Work hard to earn money and other resources

Welcome to Squarelings

Squarelings is a 4–12 player co-op puzzle platformer built around teamwork, communication and chaos.

Grab your friends and work together through a variety of levels designed to constantly change how you play the game.

One level might be all about careful platforming and perfect timing. The next might have you blasting lasers from your spaceship, stacking as food ingredients or making a painting together.

We want every level to feel different, but one rule always remains:

If one player fails, everybody fails.

You’ll need to communicate, plan ahead, improvise when that plan immediately falls apart and occasionally decide which friend deserves the blame. It's probably Orange.. again.

The controls are simple. The teamwork is not.

Play Together, However You Like

Squarelings supports Online Co-op, Local Co-op, or a combination of both, with local players able to join together in an online lobby.

There is no automatic matchmaking, so Squarelings is best played with a group of friends.

Need a few more Squarelings to complete your team? Join our Discord community to find other players, organize games, and meet fellow Squarelings.

About This Game

Everyone is welcome to try the demo. If you run into any problems, feel free to join our Discord and send feedback. Thank you very much!


Welcome to Stack Haven — a cultivation paradise where everything can be stacked!

This is more than just a card-stacking game. It is also a cozy journey of restoring a lost Haven to life. Here, you become the Master of the Haven and guide a group of adorable little creatures as they farm, refine pills, cultivate, reproduce, and rebuild this spiritual paradise from scratch.

🃏 Stack Everything and Restore the Haven

Stack two cards together, and something wonderful will happen!
Stack a sprite with a tree to gather wood; stack a sprite with a stone pile to mine stone. Stack a sprite, a meditation cushion, and Spirit Stones to begin cultivation. Stack spirit herbs with an alchemy furnace to start refining pills.


After that, you can begin building automated facilities. With simple channel connections, you can create complex production lines: from basic farming and cooking to advanced alchemy and artifact crafting. Use channels to achieve automated production, free your hands, and watch your Haven run on its own. Build a fully automated pill-refining and farming production line, and cultivate with ease.

🐼 Spirit Beast Breeding, Endless Possibilities

The little creatures here are not just workers. They have personalities, talents, and lives of their own!


  • Unique job preferences: Pandas are born cooking masters, but they may hate mining. Tea pandas can produce Enlightenment Tea that increases experience gain. Cheerful huskies are always happy — and in this world, happiness can also produce Merit. Merit can be used to obtain many wonderful things, such as the Soul-Capturing Bell, cultivation techniques, Peaches of Immortality, and even Nine-Turn Purple-Gold Pills that can be used on even the strongest sprites.


  • Genes and mutations: Want stronger helpers? Let your little creatures reproduce! Traits can be inherited, and they can also mutate. You may breed rare Dreamweaver Cats, adorable Pandas, or even legendary divine beasts such as the Nine-Tailed Fox, Phoenix, Bai Ze, Xiaotian Hound, and more!



  • Unique sprites: If you obtain a rare Nine-Tailed Fox, she can charm enemy units during battle and turn them directly into your adorable companions! Each divine beast has its own unique mechanic: the Nine-Tailed Fox can charm enemies, the Xiaotian Hound can search for Golden Crow Fragments, Bai Ze can write cultivation techniques, the Azure Dragon can summon clouds and rain and produce sweet dew, and so on. Every type of sprite has its own special mechanic, and divine beasts stand at the very peak of all sprites. But if you are lucky enough — or patient enough — you may also breed amazing ordinary sprites with extraordinary combinations of abilities: the charm of the Nine-Tailed Fox, the technique-writing ability of Bai Ze, the farming ability of a calf, and the awakening ability of a Ginseng Baby!

💌 There Is Only Travel, Never Farewell

Although this is a cultivation world, it is never cold or cruel. We refuse careless death and abandonment.


  • Wandering letter system: Is your Haven getting too crowded? Did you breed a little creature whose traits are not ideal? Don’t worry — send them out to wander the world. From time to time, they will send you letters, share the scenery they have seen, and bring back rare local specialties. They have never truly left; they are simply exploring a farther world.



  • Revival at the Soul-Nurturing Pavilion: Lost a battle? Reached the end of a lifespan? The Soul-Nurturing Pavilion will always welcome them back. By refining Revival Pills — and of course, Merit may also grant you these pills — your departed companions will eventually return home and come back to your side once more.


✨ Boundless Merit, Cozy Cultivation


  • Convert happiness into Merit: Let your little creatures eat well, live well, and work happily. The Happiness they accumulate will be converted into Merit.


  • Defend against ferocious beasts: The outside world may be dangerous, but once your sprites grow strong and join the combat squad, they can turn danger into safety and protect this peaceful land from ferocious beasts and demon invasions. Of course, if you do not want to fight, you can also spend some Spirit Stones to send enemies away — or spend even more Spirit Stones to recruit them directly.



In Stack Haven, every stack can bring a surprise, and every little creature is family.
Start now and rebuild this lost Haven!

Stackade is a tower defense game where you build with falling blocks.

Pieces drop into a column next to the board, and you drag each one into place around your HQ. Some blocks come with a tower on them, like a rifle, a minigun or a flamethrower. The rest are plain blocks, and enemies can't walk through those.

So every piece does two jobs. The towers need to end up somewhere useful, and the blocks decide which way the enemies have to walk. Make the path long enough and they get shot the whole way in.

Enemies

Each kind of enemy has its own way of getting to you. Some walk and look for the shortest way around your walls, and some don't care about walls at all. Some go straight for your HQ, some stop at a distance and pick off your towers, some blow up against your blocks, and some aren't there to fight at all, they just make a mess of your board. A layout that handles one kind well can fall apart against the next.

In Infinity a new enemy type arrives every three levels, and its boss shows up two levels later.

Between levels

You get paid after each level and spend it in the shop on towers, buff cards, grid upgrades and new shapes. There's never quite enough. Buying a tower also makes it show up more often in the pieces you get, so over a run your board ends up looking like what you bought.

The Workshop upgrades towers you already have, and the Shape Forge lets you draw your own pieces.

Modes

Campaign is four short levels that show you how everything works. Infinity is the main game, and it runs until your HQ goes down.

Also

15 towers, a rewind for bad drops, Steam achievements, 11 languages, and it works offline.

Star Claw is a claw-machine roguelite where you fling a cat's stretchy paw to grab treasure. Find your angle, build around your Charms, and follow the Starpath.

MAKE EACH RUN YOUR OWN

Unlock cats with their own gameplay perks. Equip up to five Charms and four Pawcraft commands, choose your route, and furnish My Room with the decorations you collect.

StarColony is a resource management & incremental space colony building game.

Gameplay Overview

  • Start with a new habitable planet with nothing.

  • Thaw your population, build structures, and produce resources.

  • Keep an eye on supply & demand — if you run out of food, your population will suffer.

  • Unlock more buildings, and support a growing number of population.

  • Explore various planets in space.

  • Space colonization !

Controls

  • Left click – select / interact

  • Middle mouse button – pan camera

  • Mouse wheel – zoom in / out

  • Spacebar – pause game

  • 1 – normal speed (1x)

  • 2 – double speed (2x)

Welcome aboard Star Raker!

Star Raker is a multiplayer social deduction for 4 to 12 players in which the crew of the evacuation ship takes part in a series of social experiments. The game combines several modes that radically change the rules of survival.

Forget about arcade conventions. The outcome of the match is determined solely by the human factor. Your main weapons here are communication skills, logic, and social engineering.

Available game modes:

Star Selection (minimum number of players: 4)

Scenarios inspired by thought experiments, in which you must choose only half of the 8 most deserving players. Each character has 12 unique traits, resulting in over 439,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 (439 sextillion, or 21 zeros)) possible character combinations. Make difficult moral decisions, use facts, and persuade the crew to save the gene pool.

Star Betrayal (minimum number of players: 4)

Hidden-role games taken to a whole new level. Gather around the table and try to figure out which crew member is up to no good. When trust becomes currency, you’ll have to keep tabs on every move your fellow crew members make, make tough decisions, or use any of the unique abilities from the 13 available roles to survive until the next cycle.

Star Seed Protocol is a bullet-heaven horde survival game set on a hostile alien planet. Descend to the surface, mine vital resources, defend critical positions with turrets and drones, research new technologies and weapons, and enhance your body with implants that alter the way you fight.

Features:

  • Deploy turrets and drones. Defend objectives and control the battlefield while fighting elsewhere.

  • More than running in circles. Control your character in combat - aim your weapons, raise barriers, dash through attacks.

  • Build absurd arsenals. Combine modern weapons and sci-fi arsenal with autofire, damaging fields, debuffs and more.

  • One character. Many builds. Implants change how you fight and which weapons work best for you.

  • Research new technologies. Unlock weapons, equipment, hidden projects and new combat abilities.

  • Play different mission types. Horde survival, extraction, mining and tower-defense-style objectives.

  • Explore alien biomes. Face different creatures, hazards and resources.

  • Fight massive swarms and bosses.

  • Horde survival meets tower defense and research-driven progression.

StarCinder is a fast-paced multiplayer space combat game where three rival factions battle for control across arena fights, ore extraction runs, and large-scale sector conquest. Pilot customizable fighters, unlock new ships and weapons, join squadrons, form wingman groups, or crew a two-player gunship with a dedicated pilot and gunner. Fight alongside NPC fleets, capture outposts, defend stations, escort cargo ships, and push your faction toward victory across chaotic top-down space battles built for private lobbies, quick matches, and growing multiplayer warfare.

Focus on movement

Weapons automatically seek targets and attack. You handle positioning, dodging, route planning, and survival as the arena pressure rises.

Build through 20 waves

Combat, upgrade choices, and between-wave shops alternate throughout a run. Materials serve as both experience and currency, forcing you to choose between immediate growth and the next purchase.

Combine, fuse, and evolve

Collect weapon families, fuse matching weapons of the same tier, and evolve weapons with specific items or relics. Distinct core rules, map mechanics, and Danger 0-5 reshape each run.

Elites, bosses, and long-term goals

Defeat elites and bosses for chests and special rewards. The collection, local achievements, map discoveries, Hyper, and Endless modes provide ongoing challenges.

Break through the barrage. Build your firepower.

Stardust Protocol is a sci-fi roguelite bullet-hell shooter. Pilot your fighter through dense enemy fire, chart a path across a branching star map, and shape your run with weapon upgrades and item combinations.

Break through the barrage

Weave through crossing fire and seize your opening. Unleash overdrive when the pressure peaks and turn a narrow escape into a counterattack.

Every upgrade changes your firepower

Mix scatter shots, missiles, homing fire and lasers with upgrades and items that change how you fight. Keep building your arsenal for the next encounter.

Turn your choices into firepower

Choose battles, black market stops and unknown events on a branching star map. Use supplies and upgrades to strengthen your build. Push your luck or prepare for what comes next: the choice is yours.

Take on colossal mechanical bosses

Face machines with distinct forms and attack patterns. Read the barrage, find your opening, and put your carefully assembled build to the test.

Play the free demo

Fly the PF-01 fighter through the first 10 layers of the star map, ending in a boss encounter on layer 10. Preview PF-02 through PF-05 and their skills in the hangar.

The footage above shows the game in development; not every featured boss appears in this demo.

Enjoy the combat and build crafting? Wishlist Stardust Protocol to follow its development.

Contact

· Email: 523083612@qq.com

· QQ Group: 756159629

If you can briefly note what happened and roughly which node you were on, we can follow up much faster.

Thanks for your support. Wishlist the game and follow Starzen Interactive for updates.

Cleave the Stars with a Single Slash

Countless asteroids pour in from the depths of space.

Drag the mouse to set your slash direction, wait for your targets to gather, then release at the right moment.
Angle, timing, and placement determine whether a single slash can cut through an entire cluster of asteroids.

From a Single Flash to Total Battlefield Destruction

Shatter asteroids, collect the carrots hidden inside, and keep strengthening your slash.

Start with Sword Art: Flash Slash and gradually unlock battlefield-clearing sword techniques and Secret Arts.
As you grow stronger, a single slash will sweep across an ever wider area.

Sword waves, lightning strikes, and space-rending slashes will all become part of your arsenal.

Cross the Starbelts, Hunt Bigger Prey

Build enough power to break through each region and push deeper into space.

The farther you travel into a Starbelt, the tougher your targets become—and the more likely you are to encounter rare, high-value asteroids.
Elites and powerful enemies lurking in the depths will gradually stand in your way.

Doomsday Approaches. Defend Your Homeworld

The deeper you venture into space, the closer your Homeworld comes to doomsday.

When the countdown reaches zero, the Homeworld Defense begins.
Until then, push as deep into the Starbelts as you can and gather enough power for the battle ahead.

How strong can you become before doomsday arrives?

Return to the Past, and Grow Stronger Once Again

One journey is not enough to slash your way to the end of the universe.

When your journey reaches its limit—
activate the Time Machine and return to the past.

Carry your retained progress back into the stars, surpass the limits of your previous run, and face the enemies waiting even deeper ahead.

What you couldn't cut yesterday, cut down in a single slash today.

Features

  • Drag, aim, and release for intuitive mouse-based slash combat

  • Start with Issen and gradually unlock battlefield-clearing sword techniques and Secret Arts

  • Venture through different Starbelts in pursuit of rare targets, elites, and powerful enemies

  • Defend your Homeworld against the doomsday countdown and continue growing through Time Warps

One lucky upgrade can turn a doomed run into a miracle. One bad gamble can leave your ship drifting in pieces.

Get Stronger. Fight Harder.

That’s the heart of Starforge Pirate: build a better ship, take on tougher enemies, and push your luck until the run breaks…or you do.

You play as a pirate ship battling through hostile cosmic routes. Between waves, you make quick choices: buy a new weapon, take an upgrade, visit the spaceport, or risk moving forward with the build you already have.

Enemy formations keep pressure on you with marching swarms, spiraling helixes, dive-bombers, and elite ships with their own attack patterns. Every few levels, you’ll reach the Gun & Upgrade Store, where your gold can buy new guns, ship upgrades, and choices that reshape your run.

Forge Your Arsenal

Start with a basic kinetic weapon and turn your ship into a screen-clearing weapon platform.

Add elemental weapons to your loadout:

  • Water

  • Fire

  • Ice

Each element changes how you handle enemies and bosses. The right weapon can tear through a fight; the wrong one can turn survival into a desperate scramble.

Get Stronger. Fight Harder.

Every upgrade raises the stakes.

Better gear helps you survive longer, but stronger enemies are always waiting. Each level ends in a boss fight, and each boss pushes your build harder than the last.

Survive past level 9 and you’ll face the final Mythic boss.
Manage Heat, Movement, and Pressure

Your weapons can overheat.

Fire too aggressively and you may be left unable to shoot when enemies close in. To survive, you’ll need to dodge, fire, cool down, reposition, and strike back at the right moment.

Chase Better Runs

Runs are short, tense, and built to replay.

Try different weapons, elements, upgrades, and routes as you push for stronger builds, higher scores, and a better spot on the leaderboard.

Starforge Pirate is for players who love arcade shooting, roguelite upgrades, boss fights, risky builds, and the feeling that the next run could finally be the one where everything clicks.

HOLD THE LINE

Starfort is a sci-fi tower defense game about constructing overlapping kill zones and stopping relentless enemy waves before they reach the core.

Choose your defenses, control the flow of battle, and combine specialized towers into devastating systems. Pull enemies backward with gravity wells, pierce entire lanes with railguns, deploy attack drones, reveal stealth units, and unleash powerful battlefield abilities when the line begins to collapse.

BUILD THE PERFECT DEFENSE

Every placement matters. Combine offensive towers with support structures to create defenses greater than the sum of their parts.

  • Deploy a varied arsenal of basic and advanced towers

  • Slow, expose, redirect, and destroy increasingly dangerous enemies

  • Strengthen nearby defenses with support structures

  • Generate additional resources and adapt your strategy between waves

  • Activate EMP, Strike, and Nuke abilities at critical moments

SURVIVE ESCALATING WAVES

Enemy forces grow stronger and gain new traits as each battle progresses. Prepare for stealth units, armored threats, self-repairing enemies, and powerful final bosses.

MASTER EVERY BATTLEFIELD

Fight across three distinct maps, each built around a different lane structure and defensive challenge:

  • The Rift: A tight channel through dense rock formations

Steel Wolverines: Modern Armored Combat is a turn-based tactical wargame inspired by classics of the 1990s such as Steel Panthers. It preserves their depth, freedom, and unforgiving character while modernizing the interface and controls. It brings the classic formula to a modern battlefield where only seconds may separate detecting a target from destroying it.

Observe the terrain, conduct reconnaissance, and secure favorable positions before the shooting starts. Use forests, buildings, hills, folds in the ground, and smoke screens to conceal your movements. Find hidden targets with scouts, drones, night vision, and thermal optics. Remember, however, that moving, firing, using a laser, or calling for support over the radio may reveal your presence.

Once contact is made, every decision matters. Armor facing, range, ammunition, cover, terrain, crew experience, and fire-control quality all influence the result of a shot. Even the most advanced main battle tank can be destroyed if it exposes its weaker side, drives into a prepared ambush, or operates without infantry, reconnaissance, and air-defense support.

Steel Wolverines keeps battles moving with time-saving turn mechanics. When neither side has made contact and nothing on the battlefield requires attention, enemy actions are automatically accelerated. Once combat begins, important events play out on screen, and you can manually increase the pace of the enemy turn whenever you choose.

Build Your Own Battlegroup

Choose from more than 60 vehicles and variants, including Polish PT-91s, K2s, Borsuks, and KTO Rosomaks; German Leopard 2s, Boxers, and Pumas; American Abrams, Bradleys, and Strykers; and Russian T-72s, T-80s, and T-90Ms.

Combine vehicles with infantry, anti-tank teams, reconnaissance units, drones, unmanned ground vehicles, artillery, air defense, and air support. Deploy loitering munitions such as the Warmate to strike valuable targets beyond direct-fire range. Every unit has a distinct purpose, and an effective battlegroup is more than the sum of its vehicles.

Select weapons and equipment suited to the mission. Defeat armor with APFSDS rounds, engage infantry with high-explosive ammunition, attack from long range with guided missiles, and cover your maneuvers with smoke. Reactive armor, active protection systems, counter-drone screens, jammers, and multispectral camouflage improve a vehicle’s chances of survival, but no defense offers complete protection.

Fight Standalone Skirmishes

Create your own battles and choose from five factions: NATO, the United States, Poland, Germany/Lithuania, and the Russian Federation. Any faction can fight on either side, against any other faction or against itself.

Select the battlefield size and type, time of day, weather, enemy readiness, budget, and composition of both forces. Choose from ten mission types: Attack, Defense, Meeting Engagement, Ambush, Breakthrough, Delay, Town Intrusion, Advance, Reinforce, and Screen/Guard.

Fight on procedurally generated rural and urban maps, battlefields based on real locations, or maps created by players. Forests, fields, rivers, marshes, roads, buildings, and changes in elevation affect movement, visibility, cover, and detection. Every battlefield demands a new plan and a different use of the forces available to you.

Create Your Own Battlefields

Build maps with the in-game Map Editor. Paint terrain and farmland, reshape elevation, place buildings, and trace roads, railways, rivers, streams, and footpaths. Saved maps automatically appear in the skirmish creator.

Fight a Campaign on the Polish-Lithuanian Border

The year is 2030. A NATO exercise in the Lithuanian lake country is interrupted by a series of incidents during the night. Unmarked troops cross the border, local engagements escalate into an open invasion, and the Suwałki Gap becomes one of the most important sectors of the front.

Take command of the Polish core of a multinational battlegroup and lead it through three acts of the conflict: from engagements with unidentified formations, through a defensive campaign against regular Russian forces, to a NATO counteroffensive.

Your decisions and losses remain with you between missions. Crews and units gain experience, wounded personnel undergo recovery, and the dead do not return. Damaged vehicles require repairs, heavy-ammunition expenditure burdens your logistics, and lost equipment must be replaced.

Manage Logistics Points, battlegroup value, reserves, and limited deliveries of allied equipment. Earn rank, expand your reserve capacity, and modernize your force. During the second act, choose the supporting division that will provide an attached platoon and open one of three new tank lines: K2, Leopard 2, or Abrams.

Complete optional raids to gather intelligence, unlock support, and weaken enemy forces before later battles. Victory in one operation may make the next easier, but unnecessary losses will burden your battlegroup throughout the campaign.

Fight Across a Procedural Front

The generated campaign mode lets you select the opposing sides and lead a custom battlegroup across an evolving front. Battle results determine which sectors are gained or lost, the type of the next mission, and the strength of the enemy.

Units, crews, casualties, and available replacements carry over into later battles. Return to a previously contested sector and you will find the craters and damaged buildings left by earlier fighting.

Fling forks, stab them into the floor, and smash without mercy.



Remember: it's all fruit. Smash it all.



Sometimes a fork just isn't enough.



The pot swallows the world, and you come back stronger.



Just when you think it's over, a new dimension is born.



Catch the honey pot, juggle the Flip Sword in midair, step inside a crepe.



Sweep the garden to harvest. Crank the handle all the way, and relics pour out.



Mix new boons every run and chase the ultimate build.



Don't fall for the cute act. The more fruit you smash, the closer you get to a secret you may not be ready for.

NOW IN EARLY ACCESS

Stick Crisis is out now in Early Access. New content, balance and improvements will keep arriving, shaped by your feedback. Try the free demo for a taste of the game.

A former special-operations operative now working as a security technician spots a covert shipment during a routine night shift. Following its trail pulls him into Project Obelisk — a clandestine operation assembling an impossible artifact. Fight from cover, survive each changing run and chase the mystery from the city to the jungle and into the desert.

A ROGUELITE SHOOTER WITH STAKES


Each run reshuffles combat phases, obstacles, enemy waves and rewards. When you fall, the run ends. Between attempts, spend the currency you recover on weapons and permanent stat upgrades, then return better prepared.

KEY FEATURES


  • Three battlefields: battle through the rain-soaked streets of The Incident, the hidden jungle base of Obelisk Rising and the desert pursuit of The Oasis.
  • Run-based progression: earn currency, expand your persistent arsenal and invest in permanent stat upgrades between attempts.
  • Cover-based combat: move between cover points, time your attacks and learn the patterns of increasingly dangerous enemies.
  • Destructible cover: barricades, containers, vehicles and sandbags break down under fire — the cover you are hiding behind will not last the whole fight.
  • Build-changing abilities: collect and upgrade active, passive and fused abilities as each run advances through its acts.
  • Procedural combat encounters: phases, obstacles, waves and enemy compositions change between runs.
  • An original story across three chapters: follow Project Obelisk and an impossible artifact from the city, through a hidden jungle base and into the desert.
  • Controller-ready interface: navigate the game with a controller and customize keyboard or gamepad bindings.

FOR FANS OF


Stick-figure action, tactical run-based shooters, cover combat and games that reward mastering their systems.

Join the community on Discord and help shape what comes next.

This is an action‑survival game blending highway exploration, vehicle customization and roguelike shooting. Here, your war chariot is your only hope, while the relentless unknown mist at your back and deadly monsters ahead constantly threaten your life. Fire up your engine and embark on this endless survival rampage!!!

Core Game Features:

Mobile War Chariot, Steel Fortress: Your vehicle is more than just transport — it is your hardened mobile base! Mount fire turrets on roof platforms, equip protective armor and all kinds of survival facilities. Optimize space and firepower layouts to build your one‑of‑a‑kind highway killing machine.

Base Preparation, Ready for Departure: Rest and recuperate at safe outposts before each expedition. Spend resources harvested from your previous run to upgrade character stats, enhance vehicle parts, and plan your journey. Ample fuel and powerful weapons are your only guarantee to break through encirclements.

Highway Breakout, Mow Down Foes: Drive across the perilous wastelands. Fend off swarms of alien horrors and mutated creatures by unleashing full firepower from firearms and vehicle‑mounted heavy cannons! Maneuver nimbly on the move for exhilarating shooting and satisfying horde‑clearing gameplay.

Closing‑In Mist, High‑Stakes Choices: The terrifying death mist hunts you relentlessly from behind! You must make split‑second decisions: stop to scavenge supplies, or hit the gas and flee. Fuel consumption, vehicle integrity and mist proximity will constantly test your survival wits.

Roguelike Procedural Experience: Every run is a brand‑new highway journey! Diverse gear and skill options paired with unforeseen random events make every departure full of unknowns and challenges.

There is no safe destination — only the endless road stretching onward. Modify your war chariot, grip your weapons, outrun the all‑devouring mist, and stay alive on the hazardous wilderness highways.

Home is a dumpster in the worst part of a city that already forgot you. It won't get easier from here — but it will get funnier, richer, and a lot more violent.

Stickville is a gritty 2.5D life-sim brawler about clawing your way up from the bottom of a stickman city. No money. No name. No easy way out. Work jobs, run hustles, learn to fight, take risks, and build a life of your own as you make your way from the slums to the top.

🥊 FIGHT LIKE YOU MEAN IT

Real-time melee built around stamina, range, timing, and reading your opponent. Fight with your bare fists, knives, bats, a katana with its own moveset, or even a legendary slam hammer. Learn techniques from back-alley senseis and unlock special moves capable of turning a losing fight around.

💰 PLAY THE CITY

Take a seat at blackjack, roulette, dice, and street hustles. Risk your money, read the table, and know when to walk away. Some games play fair. Others don't. Sometimes the difference between winning and losing is noticing what everyone else missed.

⚙️ TAKE ON THE PITS

Step into fight-night rings, gauntlet ladders, boardroom brawls, and other brutal arenas scattered across Stickville. Push through challenging fights, earn rewards, and keep testing how far your build can take you.

🎁 CHASE THE GOOD STUFF

Earn spins and crack open the city's strongboxes to uncover rare gear, weapons, upgrades, and other rewards. You never quite know what you're going to get — and when that rare drop finally lands, you'll know it was worth the risk.

🏙️ A CITY WITH A BOTTOM AND A TOP

Start in the rain-soaked slums and work your way through the casino strip, Midtown, and the glass towers downtown. Build a home out of a dumpster, fill it with everything you've earned, and watch your surroundings change as your life starts to move upward.

⚖️ CHOICES THAT STICK

Your choices follow you. A karma system tracks the things that actually matter — mercy, integrity, and cruelty. Decide who you want to be, who you help, and how far you're willing to go to get ahead.

🛸 ...AND THEN THERE'S THE THING AT MIDNIGHT

Some nights, the city isn't the strangest thing out there.

Keep your head up.

One street. Every choice. Your life — however you claw it out.

GEONYEONG BUILDING — PROPERTY LISTING
Six floors above ground. One basement.
Some units vacant. Viewings available.

Today's viewing is an old commercial building, the kind you could pass on any street in Korea. You expected to look around, check the details, and leave.

But the farther you go inside, the less the building matches its listing.

STILL INSIDE is a first-person 2D point-and-click horror game set in an aging Korean commercial building. Examine objects in fixed-view scenes, find clues in the records left behind, and solve puzzles as you make your way deeper inside.

Look closely at familiar places

Fluorescent-lit clinic corridors. Walls crowded with academy signs. Empty maintenance areas. Explore each scene and examine objects to find your way forward. Places that seem ordinary have a different story up close.

Piece together what was left behind

Read messages, notices, and diaries. Examine photographs. Revisit the records you collect in your archive, and connect what they tell you with the objects around you to open the way ahead.

Listen to what you cannot see

A sound through the wall. A lit corridor with no one in it. A space that should not be there. Experience familiar surroundings turning strange, and discover the traces left within them.

This building is not vacant.

Wishlist STILL INSIDE to hear when it releases.

About This Game

Still Working? is an extraction roguelike set in the soul-crushing world of corporate overtime.

You're a nameless intern at Ovortine.co. — a sweatshop of a company infamous for endless overtime and cutthroat rivalry. Here, there's only one way up the ladder: crush every coworker who stands in your way, one Showdown at a time.

Every shift, you fight your way through office floors packed with rivals, traps, and opportunities — collecting gear, growing stronger, and taking on the boss of each Rank. Showdowns are auto-battled: the real fight is won before you clock in — in your build, your gear, and whether you have the nerve to clock out at exactly the right moment.

The salary you earn only counts if you make it home alive.

Features & Mechanics

Extraction: Your salary is a risk asset — bank it or lose it
Every dollar you earn on the clock is a "risk asset" — go down, and it all vanishes. To lock in your winnings, step into the Time Clock Room and make your call:

  • Perfect Clock-Out — safely take this shift's salary home.

  • Leave Early — save time, but risk an ambush by an Elite… or a pay cut.

  • Keep Working — push to a higher Rank for bigger rewards, and bigger risks.

Push your luck, or quit while you're ahead? Every clock-out is a game of nerves.

Roguelike: No two shifts are the same

  • Each Rank takes 13 steps, and every step offers 2–3 rooms: Normal Showdown, Elite Showdown, Incident, Vending Machine, Break Room, Time Clock Room…

  • Step 13 is the Rank's boss — a.k.a. your manager, or some other jerk.

  • Randomized rooms, drops, and events force you to reinvent your build to survive ever-tougher challenges.

Deep progression, auto-battled Showdowns

  • Four item types — Tools, Credentials, Consumables, Mood Trinkets — across four tiers: Silver → Gold → Platinum → Radiant.

  • A one-of-a-kind Mood System: inflict and trigger mood states mid-Showdown to turn the tide.

  • Showdowns play out automatically, so you focus on strategy and build — and enjoy the satisfaction of steamrolling everything in your path.
    Meta progression: Turn blood money into a life
    Clock out and head home, and your salary becomes Total Assets. Spend it to unlock permanent passive perks, upgrade your Apartment, and curate your own Warehouse collection — making every next shift a little stronger.

Get to Work

And so, through blood, sweat, and tears, you claw your way up from a coffee-fetching intern to the very top of the company. Promotions, raises, stocks, mansions, jewels… wealth, power, fame — everyone scrambles to win your favor.

This is your successful life.

…Alright. Time to wake up.

You still have work tomorrow. 9 AM sharp. Don't be late.

Still Working? — Clock in, clock out, clock in again. Congratulations. This is life.

Stinky Tofu: Kitchen Survivor is a kitchen horde survivor 1.0. You’re a block of tofu that wants to live—survive waves of ingredient foes in a kitchen that cheats. Master the signature loop: hit the same foe with fire + ice to shatter. Learn that first, then push deeper.

Each run is one stage. Clear it to unlock the next. Finish all ten floors, then dive into Endless. Stages rewrite your movement logic in one line—run sideways like you’re chopping; walk straight and you’re on the cutting board.

Included

  • Signature core: fire + ice shatter, ten stages + Endless

  • Cursed food-cart contracts: risk for reward mid-run

  • Rush hour: prep / late-night peaks when the kitchen suddenly gets busy

  • Streamer chaos (optional / toggleable): Twitch or offline simulation

  • 16 unlockable tofu heroes with unique passives (feel polish ongoing)

BUILD A COLONY. SHAPE ITS WORLD.

StoneEra is a solo-developed, single-player voxel colony survival game. Establish a medieval settlement in a procedurally generated world, organize your villagers’ work, and grow from a small camp into a colony shaped by your choices. Dig into hillsides, mine resources, and build block by block.

A SETTLEMENT BUILT BY YOUR VILLAGERS

Assign gathering, farming, mining, crafting, hauling, and construction work. Villagers collect materials and turn them into food, tools, clothing, and building supplies. Balance production with food, rest, and your settlement’s needs. Your people have distinct appearances, skills, and daily routines.

DISCOVER, PRODUCE, AND TRADE

Research technologies at a research table using material samples and a resident’s study time. Develop connected production chains, from bread and timber to copper, iron, and waterworks. A travelling merchant visits by cow wagon: barter supplies, request goods for a later visit, and complete settlement commissions to earn rewards and trust.

DESIGN YOUR OWN BUILDING PLANS

Assemble a design in the Building Editor, save it locally, and place it through the gameplay Buildings menu. Rotate your plan and send villagers to prepare the site, construct it, and install furniture or production stations. Use creative editing tools, floor visibility controls, and Undo/Redo.

Building plans and the Building Editor are very early alpha experiments. Expect bugs, rough edges, and changes as development continues.

ENGINEER THE WATER AROUND YOU

Water flows through the world and reacts to terrain changes. Dig channels, redirect streams, and work with rivers, lakes, and waterfalls. Connect wooden channels and pipes, build wind-powered pumps and water wheels, and develop your own waterworks. Villagers construct the systems you plan in normal gameplay.

SHARE THE WORLD WITH ANIMALS

Explore forests, mountains, wetlands, steppe, and taiga with 20 wildlife species. Animals roam, rest, grow, and raise young. Tame animals into fenced pens, prepare feed, and care for them. Weather, four seasons, and the day/night cycle accompany your colony’s life.

BUILD AT YOUR OWN PACE

Play normal settlement mode with resident work, resources, and research progression, or use Creative mode to experiment with building and crafting. Decorate your settlement, reshape the landscape, and save your world to continue later. The interface supports English, Russian, German, French, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese.

TRY THE FREE DEMO

The demo has no session timer and includes 12 early technologies through ore smelting, plus 11 Steam achievements. Smelt your first copper bar to complete the demo journey, then keep building. Later research, crafting, and construction belong to the full game. StoneEra is in active development and is now available in Early Access.

🏪 Store Life Simulator

Build your store. Manage your business. Create your empire.

In Store Life Simulator, start with a small store and turn it into a thriving business. Buy products, organize shelves, set your prices, keep your inventory stocked, serve customers, and make decisions that will shape the growth of your business.

But running a store is about more than simply selling products. As your business grows, you will have to deal with employees, customers, cleaning, inventory, new facilities, and the challenges that come with each working day.

The choice is yours: the bigger the business, the greater the responsibilities.

🛒 MANAGE YOUR STORE

Start with a small store and build it around your strategy.

  • Buy and organize products for your customers.

  • Restock shelves and keep your inventory available.

  • Set product prices and find the balance between sales and profit.

  • Organize your store layout to create a functional environment.

  • Add and configure equipment and furniture.

  • Observe customer behavior and adapt your store to the needs of your business.

  • Expand your store as the business grows.

Every decision can influence how your store operates.

💰 BUY, SELL, AND GROW YOUR BUSINESS

Managing money is an essential part of running a business.

Use the money you earn to buy products, improve your store, hire employees, and invest in expanding your company.

As your operation grows, so do the costs of maintaining and managing it.

Invest your profits carefully and decide where your money is worth spending.

👥 HIRE AND MANAGE EMPLOYEES

As your store grows, doing everything yourself is no longer enough.

Hire employees to help with different store tasks:

  • 🧾 Cashiers — help serve customers at the checkout counters.

  • 📦 Stockers — keep shelves stocked.

  • 🧹 Cleaners — help keep the store clean.

  • 🛡️ Security Guards — help protect the store and maintain order.

Employees allow you to delegate tasks and focus on managing and expanding your business.

🛍️ CUSTOMERS AND THE SHOPPING EXPERIENCE

Your store needs customers to survive.

Customers enter the store, look for the products they want to buy, move through the different areas, choose their items, and head to the checkout counters to complete their purchases.

A disorganized store, empty shelves, or slow service can affect your customers' experience.

Watch what happens in your store and find ways to improve how the business operates.

🏗️ BUILD AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR STORE

Your store is your business space.

Arrange furniture, place shelves, configure equipment, and create a layout that works for you.

As you unlock new possibilities, you can gradually transform a small store into a larger and more complete commercial space.

Build a store that works the way you want it to.

🌙 A BUSINESS THAT RUNS BY THE DAY

Every day brings new opportunities and new challenges.

During the day, focus on managing your store, serving customers, and completing the tasks needed to keep the business running.

When it is time to close, you can return home and prepare for the next day.

Rest marks the beginning of a new day, allowing you to plan your next steps and decide how you want to continue developing your business.

🏬 EXPAND YOUR EMPIRE

One store can be just the beginning.

As your business grows, you can invest in acquiring new locations and expand your company.

Each new store brings new business opportunities as well as new responsibilities.

Start with a small store and work toward building a true retail company.

📈 PROGRESS AND UNLOCK NEW POSSIBILITIES

Your company's growth follows your progression.

Gain experience, increase your resources, and unlock new possibilities to improve your operation.

The more your company grows, the more tools you will have available to manage your business.

🎨 A LIVING LOW POLY WORLD

Store Life Simulator features a Low Poly visual style, creating a colorful and approachable world where stores, customers, employees, and other NPCs bring the environment to life.

Explore the city, watch customers move through the world, and see your store transform as your business grows.

🚀 BUILD YOUR BUSINESS

Start small.

Sell your first products.

Serve your first customers.

Hire your first employees.

Open new stores.

And transform your small business into a true retail empire.

Your business. Your store. Your decisions.

Welcome to Store Life Simulator.
